free_tier.stated: No clear public storage cap found. Platform is free SaaS on S3; documented pain point is a '1GB per day' quota on modelState (compute artifacts), not on file storage.
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that no cap exists
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: per-object-cap: none documented for plain files; 1 GB/day on modelState. Retention: indefinite for public content

egress.terms: Free to download for public projects; anonymous download of public entities is supported.

tooling: Python/Java/R clients (`synapseclient`), REST API, and a built-in Docker registry. Also supports custom storage locations (your own S3/GCS) — which makes it a metadata layer over someone else's bucket rather than storage itself.
chaining: Unlimited projects per certified user. The interesting chain is the inverse: point Synapse at a custom S3/GCS location and you get a free DOI-style sharing and permissions layer over any bucket you already have.
limits_note: per-object-cap: none documented for plain files; 1 GB/day on modelState. Retention: indefinite for public content. Gate: upload requires 'certified user' status (a quiz), so no anonymous write path exists.
